{{Top|leg}}
'''"Daa Hutt muna"''' was a [[Music/Legends|song]] performed by the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] singer [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]. Accompanied by three [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancers, Snootles performed the song in front of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] at [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder|Gardulla the Hutt's]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace|Palace]] located in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The musical number of "Daa Hutt muna" shown in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Hunt for Ziro]]" was an homage to the opening sequence of the [[1984]] film [[W:c:indianajones:Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom|''Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom'']], in which [[W:c:indianajones:Willie Scott|Willie Scott]] and her dancers perform in Mandarin the song [[W:c:indianajones:Anything Goes|''Anything Goes'']] at [[W:c:indianajones:Club Obi-Wan|Club Obi-Wan]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>
